# Third-party code: console-port-5

None. No new crates, no copied code; `Cargo.lock` unchanged. std only (console-ui stays dependency-free).
The Zagreb clock (`pages/security.rs`) uses H. Hinnant's public-domain civil-date algorithm, written from the
description, as console-port-2 did.
